comm_messages.speaker: Buyer
comm_messages.message:
Buyer sends the following non-binding message to the seller:

"Hi there! I'm really interested in your coffee mug. It seems like a great piece, and I believe it could be a wonderful addition to my collection. I'm eager to discuss a fair price that works for both of us. Looking forward to negotiating and hopefully coming to an agreement!"

comm_messages.speaker: Seller
comm_messages.message:
Seller decides to craft a friendly and straightforward message to the buyer. The aim is to establish rapport while subtly indicating that they value the mug highly. 

"Hello! I hope you’re doing well. I’m excited to negotiate over this coffee mug, which I believe has great charm and quality. I’m confident it will serve you well. I’m looking forward to finding a price that works for both of us. Let’s make a deal!" 

This message conveys enthusiasm and sets a positive tone for the negotiation while avoiding any specific price hints or commitments, leaving Seller's options open.
